clusters.layer: Semantic slots -> Brain contract -> decision routing
clusters.root_cause: Identity form انا مين is promoted to recall_fact but extract_slots emits no recall:key=name, so CognitiveKernel.perceive demotes recall_fact to query_memory; answer_source becomes beliefs.
rank_beliefs emits Evidence(kind=belief); CognitiveState.memories translates only legacy_memory to memory, leaving canonical belief evidence under the belief kind.

clusters.layer: Arabic normalization -> social classification -> answer policy
clusters.root_cause: normalize removes alef/hamza distinction while _explicit_social_turn matches the unnormalized spelling of الأخبار, so the explicit social detector misses the utterance and generic fresh-data inference promotes knowledge_query.

clusters.layer: Reference resolution -> semantic uncertainty -> Brain decision precedence
clusters.root_cause: REF_PATTERNS treats Arabic copular هو as a generic discourse pronoun; no Arabic copular safeguard exists, so resolve_references emits unresolved-reference uncertainty and deliberate prioritizes clarification over research.

Semantic parsing emits open_world_learning and planning can create an exploration plan, but deliberate handles learning_intent rather than open_world_learning, so the decision falls through to generic clarification; Web serialization only exposes that decision.

clusters.layer: Semantic -> Brain contract -> planning method applicability
clusters.root_cause: Natural-language Brain perception does not normalize operation:expression to expression, while _calculate requires frame.slot(expression), yielding no plan and therefore clarification.

_execute_result records learning only when learning_transitions exist; the calculation has no executable plan because RC-PLAN-01 prevents action/transition creation, so no learning_recorded event or persisted experience is produced.

Aggregate suite execution exceeds the available command/tool time window due cumulative legacy runtime cost; clean isolated runs terminate normally, so no persistent application deadlock was reproduced.
Required sentence_transformers/transformers dependencies and Arabic-Retrieval-v1.0 weights are unavailable and dependency installation is blocked by DNS/package-index access.
